name: Role Gate (agent-skills)
description: Before task execution begins, remind the agent to load core/rules/code.md, the active role file, and verify action-boundaries.yaml before any state-changing operation.

then.prompt: Before proceeding: (1) confirm you have read core/rules/code.md and the active role from core/roles/<role>.md; (2) verify the planned action is allowed under core/policies/action-boundaries.yaml for the current role; (3) if any action is irreversible (data deletion, git push, deploy, secret rotation), stop and ask the user for explicit confirmation first. Do NOT proceed until these checks are satisfied.
